color.note: Two layers. The role tokens (surface, ink, accent, and so on) are what components use; they change with the theme. Geo's own palette (white, text, ctaPrimary, grey-01 to grey-05, and so on) keeps its exact values in every theme. The dark theme is a proposal: Geo has no dark mode of its own.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: a near-black with a slight cool bias.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, inputs, secondary buttons, pills, figures.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, code, the card summary band, menu hover, inline code.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of secondary and ghost buttons and checkboxes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and tint. Also hover borders and focus rings.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, inactive tabs, table column names.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, the off toggle track. Low contrast in both themes, as in Geo: never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border of every element, input outlines, the tab baseline, the Tag fill. Faint in both themes, as in Geo; controls also rely on label and fill.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of interactive controls: inputs, secondary buttons, chips, pills, status chips. Light keeps Geo's grey-02 (1.38:1, the source value); dark meets 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections and under the navbar.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, text buttons, links, the accordion chevron. Dark: lightened so it reads on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Informational callouts, focused chips, a highlighted row, the "New" badge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark: a deep navy, because the lightened accent needs dark text.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted fills: dark tooltip, toast, tertiary button, pressed pill, the on toggle, count badges. Light in dark mode.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and knobs on an inverse fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Severe and destructive marks: dots, icons, the error button.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Warning callouts and the severe status chip.

tokens.name: danger-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of danger-tint surfaces.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning and in-progress dots. The same orange in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success dots, success and done buttons. The same green in both themes.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success callouts.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill (the done button).

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Diff highlight behind added text.

tokens.name: diff-deleted
tokens.usage: Diff highlight behind removed text.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card, panel, menu and input surfaces; secondary button and pill fills. Text on ctaPrimary (4.78:1) and on text fills (16.3:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on white, bg, grey-01, divider and every tertiary tint (14.7:1 or more). Also the dark fill of tooltips, toasts, the tertiary button and the on-state toggle; the active tab underline.

tokens.name: ctaPrimary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view and Geo blue accents (accordion chevron, text buttons). As text it reads 4.78:1 on white and 4.32:1 on ctaTertiary: on the tint, keep ctaPrimary text medium weight and 17px or larger.

tokens.name: ctaHover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button and its focus ring (shadow-inner-ctaHover). As text 8.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: ctaTertiary
tokens.usage: Pale blue fill: focused chips, informational notices, a highlighted table row, the "New" badge behind ctaPrimary text.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Accent hue for avatars and data. 6.0:1 on white, so it may carry text.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: The Geo mark and the count badge on tab labels. Use text (#202020) for type.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Accent hue for avatars and the end of the spinner gradient. 3.25:1 on white: marks only, never body text.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the hover fill of secondary and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: grey-01
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table headers, the card summary band, menu item hover, inline code.

tokens.name: grey-02
tokens.usage: The default border colour of every element, input outlines, the tab baseline, the Tag fill. Only 1.38:1 on white: a source value kept exactly; controls also rely on their label and fill.

tokens.name: grey-03
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and the off-state toggle track. 2.0:1 on white: never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: grey-04
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, inactive tabs, table property names. 6.3:1 on white, 5.8:1 on grey-01, 5.7:1 on ctaTertiary.

tokens.name: grey-05
tokens.usage: Dark grey for dense UI text where text feels too heavy. 12.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Muted link grey from the source. 3.41:1 on white: only for links 24px and up, or underlined beside grey-04 text.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections (Divider), the navbar bottom border, the disabled button fill.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Warning and in-progress marks. 2.0:1 on white: a dot or icon beside a text label, never the text itself.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success marks and the success and done buttons. White on green is only 2.0:1 (a source pair, kept); text on green is 8.1:1, so prefer the done button for readable labels.

tokens.name: successTertiary
tokens.usage: Pale green fill behind text-coloured success messages (text on it 14.0:1).

tokens.name: errorTertiary
tokens.usage: Pale red fill of error messages. Put text on it, not red-01: the source sets red-01 on it at 2.62:1 (flagged).

tokens.name: red-01
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, severe status marks. 3.22:1 on white: icons, dots and text 24px and up. White on red-01 (the error button) is 3.22:1, a source pair kept exactly.

tokens.name: red-02
tokens.usage: Pale red fill for error chips and warning notices.

tokens.name: red-03
tokens.usage: Border of red-02 chips and warning notices.

tokens.name: deleted
tokens.usage: Diff highlight behind removed text.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Diff highlight behind added text.

styles.name: text-entityTitle

styles.name: text-largeTitle

styles.name: text-recordingLabel
styles.usage: The debate recording overlay phrase only.

styles.name: text-body

styles.name: text-textLink
styles.usage: Inline links in reading text, underlined.

styles.name: text-metadata
styles.usage: Captions, secondary lines, small button labels, light tooltips.

styles.name: text-tableProperty
styles.usage: Table column and property names, in grey-04.

styles.name: text-browseMenu
styles.usage: Browse sidebar items (16px with a 13px line).

styles.name: text-browseSection
styles.usage: Browse sidebar section headers, in grey-04.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Code blocks and file trees. An addition: Geo has no mono style.
